pages.text: Press $(k:origins.view_origin) to see your origin — Origins is the framework running IridescentCraft's entire class and race system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Origins provides the selection UI and the power system. All class and race abilities are implemented as Origins powers in the pack's own datapacks.$(br2)$(bold)Selection:$() You are prompted to select Race and Class when first joining a world. If you miss it, press $(k:origins.view_origin). Your primary origin power fires on $(k:origins.primary_active).

$(bold)Limitations to know:$() Origins powers are applied on select. If your class or race appears broken after a pack update, the $(bold)/origin set$() command (yours in singleplayer, an admin's on the server) re-applies it.$(br2)$(bold)Race is permanent.$() Class respec uses the Class Altar.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pick with $(l:icraft:welcome/class_guide)Pick Your Origin, Race & Class$(/l).$()
